name: Modern White Marble Waffle Weave Fabric Shower Curtain with Waterproof PEVA Liner Set
description: Selling a stylish bathroom upgrade bundle featuring a heavyweight 100% polyester fabric outer shower curtain with a premium white/grey marble pattern and classic waffle weave texture [Walmart](https://walmart.com). It includes a matching semi-transparent/white waterproof PEVA liner to protect your floors from splashes [Walmart](https://walmart.com). Fits standard bathtub/shower areas (72 x 72 inches) and comes with rust-resistant metal grommet holes at the top header. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly apartment with a resident cat. Both the fabric curtain and plastic liner have been thoroughly washed, sanitized, and lint-rolled, though minor pet dust particles might remain due to static. Does NOT come with secondary retail storage packaging or bags; local pickup buyers, please bring your own tote container.
contact_note: Includes both the marble waffle outer fabric curtain and the inner waterproof liner. Folds incredibly flat and takes zero trunk space. Note: From a cat-friendly apartment.
meta_description: Modern White Marble Waffle Weave Fabric Shower Curtain and waterproof inner liner set for sale. Standard 72x72 size, fully washed and sanitized. Good condition.
name_zh: 北欧现代大理石纹华夫格加厚织物浴帘 + 防水防霉内衬帘组合套装 (72x72寸)
description_zh: 低价转让一套颜值很高的浴室/浴缸双层浴帘组合。外层为高颜值北欧风白灰大理石纹理的涤纶布艺织物帘，表面带经典的豪华酒店华夫格立体编织肌理 [Walmart](https://walmart.com)；内层搭配一块专用的白色/半透明加厚防水防霉 PEVA 材质防溅水内衬帘 [Walmart](https://walmart.com)，干湿分离效果极佳。标准的 72x72 英寸正方形规格，顶部配有防锈金属扣眼。**诚实披露**：家里养猫，属于宠物友好型环境。出货前织物帘已完成高水位清洗消毒，塑料内衬帘也进行了彻底刷洗和去静电除毛，但因材质极易产生静电，可能还会附着微量游离猫毛残余。本家居用品不附带原厂二次包装袋，本地自提的买家朋友请自带一个小手提袋将其装走。
